notes: Adapted from the fork's shadow_priest/apls/p1.apl.json. Fix round 1: Devouring Plague's rank was moved back to 5 (19279), not forward to spellconst's top rank 6 (19280) -- sim/priest/devouring_plague.go's registration loop (`for rank := 1; rank < DevouringPlagueRanks; rank++` with DevouringPlagueRanks = 6) never registers rank 6, so 19280 is not castable in this engine build even though it is the client's current top rank; 19279 is the highest rank the engine actually registers. The excluded rank is recorded as an engine follow-up, not fixed here by reverting spellconst's own answer. Shadow Word: Death (1309636, sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go) is now implemented (rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28), with Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent's below-20-percent crit bonus read through the engine's execute-phase approximation; the Mind Blast-then-Mind Flay fallback immediately beneath it stays in place for when Shadow Word: Death is still on its 15 s cooldown inside the same execute window. Shadowform is still cast at prepull, Shadow Word: Pain is maintained with the same fight-end guard as the source preset, and Inner Focus into Devouring Plague, Mind Blast on cooldown, and Mind Flay as filler are otherwise unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Shadow Word: Pain is kept up unless the fight is about to end, when refreshing it would waste most of the DoT.

Shadow Word: Death (sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go): Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent gives it bonus crit chance below 20% target health, read through the engine's execute-phase approximation (isExecutePhase E20, the same primitive this line already used).
Era fallback for the execute window when Shadow Word: Death is on its own 15 s cooldown: Mind Blast on cooldown, else Mind Flay.

Inner Focus into Devouring Plague: a free, empowered cast of the priest's biggest single-target nuke. Fix round 1: rank 6 (19280, spellconst's current top rank) is excluded by an off-by-one in the engine's registration loop; rank 5 (19279) is the highest rank the engine actually registers, and the excluded rank is an engine follow-up.
Mind Flay fills every remaining global, including the rest of the execute fallback above.
